source: Support options in Abu Dhabi, matching stepped care (self-help, family doctor, online therapy, specialist) with 800-SAKINA and 999/998 always available. From the project's support-options table. DRAFT: booking routes and costs to be confirmed with each provider; the psychiatrist and the licensed provider approve the final text.

options.title: Coping cards and guides
options.what: Short exercises inside borderless: breathing, grounding, STOP, TIP and more, plus guides for sleep and worry over a few weeks.
options.forWho: Mild scores, or anyone while they wait for a reply.
options.handOff: No referral needed. Open them any time from the menu or your timeline.

options.title: SEHA primary care
options.what: Abu Dhabi's public family doctor and community clinics. Mental health screenings are part of primary care, and a family doctor can treat mild to moderate low mood or anxiety and look after physical health at the same time.
options.forWho: Ongoing low mood or worry, especially if you also have a physical health condition.
options.cost: Check your insurance plan for cover and any co-payment.
options.handOff: Your clinician refers you and you book at your nearest SEHA clinic. With your consent, they can give you a summary for your family doctor.

options.title: Pura app
options.what: An app from PureHealth, SEHA's parent company. Private online sessions with licensed psychologists and psychiatrists from SAKINA, from anywhere in the UAE, plus guided meditations, educational content and resilience resources.
options.forWho: If you'd like therapy but prefer online, or can't easily get to a clinic.
options.cost: Check the app for prices and insurance cover.
options.handOff: Your clinician suggests it; you download the app and book a session.

options.title: SAKINA
options.what: SEHA's specialist mental health network: psychiatry, psychology, child and adolescent services, memory and elderly care, family support and community mental health.
options.forWho: Moderate to severe scores, children and teenagers, older adults, or when a clinician thinks specialist care is needed.
options.cost: Check your insurance plan for cover.
options.handOff: Your clinician refers you and tells you what to expect. In most cases no referral is required.

options.title: 800-SAKINA (800 725462)
options.what: A free, 24/7 support line in Arabic and English, with psychological first aid and direct access to qualified mental health professionals.
options.forWho: Anyone who needs to talk to a professional now, at any hour.
options.handOff: Call any time. No referral needed.

options.title: 999 (police) or 998 (ambulance)
options.forWho: If you or someone else is in immediate danger.
options.handOff: Call straight away. The crisis page shows these first.
